dict.string: Unstuck reads your steps, sleep, and heart rate to show your body's patterns — visible only to you, never leaves your device.
Unstuck listens only when you press the Action Button to capture a thought. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
Unstuck transcribes what you say into a thought node on your brain map. Stays on your device.
Unstuck shows your upcoming events — from any calendar you've added (Apple, Google, Outlook) — in your time space, and gently flags overlaps. Read-only, stays on your device.
Unstuck surfaces your due reminders in your time space so they're part of the picture. Read-only, stays on your device.
